meta.title: AQA GCSE English Language Mock Paper Bank
meta.subtitle: Original AQA-style GCSE English Language practice papers with secure OpenAI-assisted marking
notes: All sources, extracts and questions are original mock materials and are not official AQA papers.
Each generated paper contains four questions worth 4, 8, 20 and 40 marks and is designed for 1 hour 25 minutes.
The browser saves the selected paper pack and student responses locally on that device.

questions.instructionsTop: For this question, compare how the writers convey their different perspectives or feelings.
questions.questionText: Compare how the writers convey their different perspectives on time away from school in Source A and Source B.
bulletPoints: Compare the writers' different ideas and perspectives
Compare how they use methods to convey these views
Support your answer with references to both sources

rubric.name: AO3 comparison
rubric.notes: Reward developed comparison of perspectives and methods across both sources.
